security.changePasswordDescription: Update your password to keep your account secure
security.passwordChangedMessage: Your password has been changed successfully.
security.passwordHint: Password must be at least 8 characters and contain uppercase, lowercase, and numbers.

validation.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.passwordUppercase: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter
validation.passwordLowercase: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter
validation.passwordNumber: Password must contain at least one number
validation.newPasswordSameAsCurrent: New password must be different from current password

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account using a TOTP authenticator app
twoFactor.enableDescription: Confirm your password to continue with 2FA setup
twoFactor.securityInfo: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to your account. You will need to enter a code from your authenticator app each time you sign in.
twoFactor.recommendedApps: We recommend using apps like Google Authenticator, Authy, or 1Password.
twoFactor.scanQRCodeDescription: Use your authenticator app to scan this QR code
twoFactor.scanInstruction: Open your authenticator app (like Google Authenticator, Authy, or 1Password) and scan the QR code below.
twoFactor.cantScan: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
twoFactor.verifyCodeDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.verifyInstruction: Enter the verification code displayed in your authenticator app to complete setup.

backupCodes.title: Save Your Backup Codes
backupCodes.description: Store these codes safely - you'll need them if you lose access to your authenticator
backupCodes.label: Backup Codes
backupCodes.regenerateWarning: This will invalidate all existing backup codes
backupCodes.newCodesDescription: Store these codes safely - your old codes are now invalid
backupCodes.regenerateAlert: All existing backup codes will be permanently deleted and replaced with new ones.
backupCodes.importantMessage: Each backup code can only be used once. Store them in a secure location like a password manager.
backupCodes.importantMessageShort: Each backup code can only be used once. Store them in a secure location.
backupCodes.downloadHeader: Admin Portal - Two-Factor Authentication Backup Codes
backupCodes.downloadInstruction: Store these codes in a safe place. Each code can only be used once.
backupCodes.lowCodesWarning: You have only {{count}} backup code(s) remaining. Consider regenerating your backup codes.
backupCodes.noCodesWarning: You have no backup codes remaining. Regenerate new codes immediately to avoid being locked out.
